name: Libera Suite
tagline: Desktop office apps on the Euro-Office editors
description: Words, Tables and Slides as desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux, with a Visio viewer and a PDF editor. The editors come from Euro-Office, the European fork of ONLYOFFICE, so Office files are edited in their own format. Everything runs locally: no account, no cloud service, no telemetry.
licenseNote: The desktop host is Apache-2.0; the editor components it downloads (Euro-Office and its patches) are AGPL-3.0. Both are free software and are packaged separately.
backing: Abilian, a French free-software company, building on the Euro-Office editors maintained by Nextcloud, IONOS and others

maturity.rationale: Public beta since October 2026, at version 0.7 with 1.0 not yet dated. The editors underneath come from the long-established ONLYOFFICE code base, but the packaging around them is new: installers are not yet code-signed, updates are not automatic, and there is no managed deployment for administrators.

strengths: Edits .docx, .xlsx and .pptx in their own format, with the Office-file fidelity of the ONLYOFFICE editors
Works entirely offline with no account, no subscription and no telemetry
Installs per user without administrator rights, from an installer, Homebrew, Flatpak or pip
Can convert documents in bulk from the command line
weaknesses: Young: a beta from a single small company, with features and behaviour still changing between releases
No real-time co-editing; Nextcloud, ownCloud and Seafile storage is planned but not built yet
No macros and no mail merge
Installers are not code-signed, so Windows and macOS warn on first launch, and there is no MSI or other deployment tooling for managed fleets yet
Opens legacy .doc files but cannot save them, and Visio files are view-only

featureNotes.browser-coediting: Desktop only; file-platform integration is on the roadmap
featureNotes.odf-native: Opens and saves ODF by converting
